verdict.rationale: Logseq documents creating wiki-style links by typing `[[]]` (plus block references with `(())`) and hover previews of references. It also documents a "linked references" section, though only for Journals pages, which shows mentions of that day's date, implying in-context backlinks. Nothing in the pack covers unlinked mentions, and backlinks on arbitrary pages are only implied. Missing for 10: documented unlinked-mentions feature, explicit backlinks/linked-references panel on every page, independent or hands-on corroboration of backlink context display.
